notes.title: v1.0.0 is Live!
notes.content:
[b]New Language Additions to the Game:[/b]
[list]
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Traditional Chinese
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[/list]
[b]Note:[/b] [i]To view the Traditional Chinese language in the game, please set your Windows language to Traditional Chinese.[/i]

[list]
[*] Minor bug fixes and minor performance improvements
[/list]
[b]Next Update Plans:[/b]
In the next update, I plan to add Linux support and introduce badges to the game.

Thank you for your ongoing support!
-Cem Boray
